name: Headphone Display Stand
summary: Unbranded floor display with six generic over-ear headphones on curved hooks.
description: Original graphite twin-post stand for S13, with a blank porcelain header, six curved J hooks and padded saddles, two rows of three black/white/grey over-ear headphones, a lower shelf and a small blank price card. No text, logos or external assets.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry and three shared PBR materials; no external assets, textures, fonts, packaging or logos.
accuracy_notes: Static visual store fixture. Original generic headphone geometry; no audio, electrical behavior, product specifications or physical certification. Three exported primitives are measured per asset; full 17-shop mall draw-call budget and frame rate are unverified. Physical Android/iOS and WebKit NOT TESTED.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry and materials. No external assets.
